bio.text: Richard Hricik is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina attorney general in 2026, according to the SC Daily Gazette's voter guide.
According to the voter guide, Hricik lives in Mount Pleasant and has more than 30 years of experience as a trial and appellate attorney.

The guide says Hricik is a part-time law professor at William & Mary Law School, Hricik's alma mater, and at the Charleston School of Law, and was previously a professor at Charleston Southern University.
